description: This file defines the SignatureV4 class implementing AWS Signature Version 4 signing process for HTTP requests, including methods for signing, presigning, and handling AWS-specific headers. It is a core component of the AWS SDK for PHP, providing mechanisms for request authentication and URL signing.

classes.name: SignatureV4
classes.description: Implements AWS Signature Version 4 signing for HTTP requests, including signing and presigning URLs, managing headers, and integrating with AWS CRT for advanced cryptographic signing (Signature V4A).

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs an HTTP request with AWS Signature V4, adding Authorization headers.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for temporary access to AWS resources.

methods.name: convertPostToGet
methods.description: Converts a POST request with form data into a GET request with query parameters for signing.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Calculates the payload hash or indicates unsigned payload based on request headers and options.

methods.name: getPresignedPayload
methods.description: Retrieves payload information used for presigning.

methods.name: createCanonicalizedPath
methods.description: Creates a canonicalized path string for signature calculation.

methods.name: createStringToSign
methods.description: Constructs the string to sign based on request time, scope, and request data.

methods.name: createPresignedRequest
methods.description: Prepares a request for presigning by adding security tokens.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Builds canonical request headers and string for signing.

methods.name: getCanonicalizedQuery
methods.description: Generates a canonicalized query string for signing.

methods.name: convertToTimestamp
methods.description: Converts date/time input into a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: convertExpires
methods.description: Calculates expiration duration for presigned URLs, ensuring it is within limits.

methods.name: moveHeadersToQuery
methods.description: Moves certain headers into URL query parameters for signing.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses and normalizes an HTTP request into components for signing.

methods.name: buildRequest
methods.description: Constructs a PSR-7 request object from signing data.

methods.name: verifyCRTLoaded
methods.description: Checks that the AWS CRT extension is loaded for Signature V4A functionality.

methods.name: createCRTStaticCredentialsProvider
methods.description: Creates a static credentials provider for CRT signing.

methods.name: removeIllegalV4aHeaders
methods.description: Removes headers incompatible with Signature V4A signing process.

methods.name: CRTRequestFromGuzzleRequest
methods.description: Converts a Guzzle PSR-7 request to AWS CRT Request object.

methods.name: signWithV4a
methods.description: Performs request signing using AWS CRT's Signature V4A method for asymmetric keys.

methods.name: presignWithV4a
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL using AWS CRT's Signature V4A.
